Actor Nana Patekar had a passion for cooking and feeding people wholeheartedly; he would often cook for the entire film crew, co-stars, and large gatherings of up to 200 people. He prepared non-vegetarian dishes like *mutton paya*, *keema kaleji*, and *bheja*, as well as a special fish dish made with a blend of home-ground spices. However, when cooking for friends or colleagues, he would also get his guests to pitch in—tasks like chopping and peeling vegetables—and once even made a director wash the dishes. At his 10-acre farmhouse near Sinhagad Fort in Pune, Nana grew fresh vegetables, tended to his livestock, and frequently cooked meals on a traditional wood-fired stove.

snippet.title: Delhi Police Checks Buses at Chilla Border Ahead of October 10 Jantar Mantar Protest
snippet.description:
Ahead of today’s protest at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, Delhi Police personnel were seen stopping a private bus at the Chilla border between Uttar Pradesh and Delhi. Police checked the passenger list on the conductor’s phone and asked commuters about their destinations. Most passengers said they were heading to Kashmere Gate.

A police personnel said commercial four-wheelers were also being checked, as people could book Ola and Uber rides to reach Jantar Mantar.

localized.description:
Ahead of today’s protest at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, Delhi Police personnel were seen stopping a private bus at the Chilla border between Uttar Pradesh and Delhi. Police checked the passenger list on the conductor’s phone and asked commuters about their destinations. Most passengers said they were heading to Kashmere Gate.

A police personnel said commercial four-wheelers were also being checked, as people could book Ola and Uber rides to reach Jantar Mantar.

snippet.title: Ronaldo terharu dengan dukungan fans Al Nassr usai dirinya dicampakkan Timnas Portugal
snippet.description:
Ronaldo beneran terharu setelah melihat apa yang dilakukan para suporter Al-Nassr di tribun setelah ia dicampakkan timnas Portugal. 
Ronaldo sempat mendapatkan salah satu perlakuan terburuk yang pernah dibayangkan oleh seorang legenda sepak bola dari timnas Portugal. Namun, saat kembali ke Al-Nassr, ia dibuat sangat terkejut dengan apa yang dilihatnya.
Ronaldo tidak mendapatkan penghormatan yang layaknya ia dapatkan di Portugal—baik dari para pemain, media, maupun dari para suporternya sendiri.
Begitu kembali ke Al-Nassr, para suporter telah menyiapkan ribuan kertas bertuliskan CR7, di mana setiap hurufnya menyoroti pencapaian luar biasa Ronaldo. Mereka juga membentangkan tifo raksasa yang dipersembahkan khusus untuk sang kapten, bertuliskan "Keagungan Itu Diraih, Bukan Diberikan".
Seluruh isi stadion menyanyikan nama Ronaldo dengan sekuat tenaga, menunjukkan rasa cinta dan dukungan yang sangat ia butuhkan setelah semua hal pahit yang dialaminya di Portugal.

snippet.title: 전쟁 정보마저 끊길 판...트럼프 경고에 벼랑 끝 우크라이나 [자막뉴스]  / YTN
snippet.description:
"평화 구상안 논의…러시아 경유 합의 소식 통보"
"러시아 정유시설 공습 계속되면 정보 공유 중단"
"우크라이나, 미국 정보 활용해 러시아 시설 공습"

지난 9일 트럼프 대통령의 외교 특사인 스티브 윗코프와 사위 재러드 쿠슈너는 우크라이나 대표단을 미국 마이애미로 불렀습니다.

우크라이나 전쟁을 끝내기 위한 이른바 '평화 구상'을 논의하기 위한 자리에서 미국은 러시아와의 경유 공급 합의 소식을 통보했습니다.

더는 러시아 정유시설을 공격하지 말라는 점도 분명히 했습니다.

그러면서 만약 공습이 계속된다면 전쟁 관련 정보 공유를 중단할 수 있다고 경고했습니다.

사실상 미국의 정보에 의지해 전쟁을 이어가고 있는 우크라이나 입장에서는 날벼락 같은 소식입니다.

왜 러시아는 놔두고 우리만 막느냐는 볼멘소리에도 트럼프 대통령의 단호한 요구라고 선을 그었습니다.

[도널드 트럼프 / 미국 대통령 : 우리 농가와 목장주에게 또 다른 나라에도 계속 영향을 미치게 해선 안 됩니다. 당장 그만두는 게 좋을 겁니다.]

그런데 젤렌스키 대통령이 보란 듯이 곧바로 러시아 정유 시설을 공습하자, 트럼프 대통령은 아예 정권 교체 카드를 꺼내 들었습니다.

다음 달 중간선거를 앞두고 외교 성과가 시급한 트럼프는 더는 기다릴 여유가 없습니다.

[도널드 트럼프 / 미국 대통령 : 이제 그만 선거를 치러야 합니다. 해결할 기회가 있었어요. 유가를 끌어올리게 둘 수 없어요. 할 만큼 했어요.]

젤렌스키는 이미 2024년에 임기가 끝났지만, 러시아 침공 이후 계엄령 선포로 집권을 이어가고 있습니다.

트럼프 대통령은 지난해에도 젤렌스키를 향해 '선거 없는 대통령'이라며 선거 실시를 압박했습니다.

The government has stepped up measures to stop Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) from advancing with its long march, as containers remain in place at key entry and exit points of Rawalpindi. The roadblocks have disrupted traffic flow, created difficulties for commuters, and affected business activities across the city. Citizens travelling to and from Taxila, Attock, and other nearby areas are facing significant challenges due to the restrictions.

The ongoing blockade has raised concerns about public inconvenience, the financial burden on taxpayers, and the impact on local businesses. Containers placed along major roads have restricted movement, causing long traffic queues and making daily commuting increasingly difficult for residents, workers, traders, and passengers.

Since September 24, the rental cost for these containers has reportedly reached Rs 7.5 million. If the current situation continues for another two weeks, the total amount could rise to approximately Rs 15 million.

These figures have sparked questions about the financial implications of the government's efforts to prevent the PTI long march. The rental expenses are expected to be covered through public funds, raising concerns about whether taxpayers should bear the cost of prolonged road closures and security arrangements.

The restrictions have also created difficulties for traders and business owners.
